Blood Sugar Imbalance

Ailment blood-sugar glucose diabetes insulin metabolic

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.

Symptoms

  • frequent urination
  • increased thirst
  • fatigue
  • blurred vision
  • slow healing

    Nerve damage causing pain, tingling, and numbness, often in extremities.
  • Anxiety & Stress
    Psychological state of worry, nervousness, or fear that is difficult to control and affects daily functioning.

    Uncontrollable urge to move legs, usually due to uncomfortable sensations.
  • Tinnitus
    Perception of noise or ringing in the ears when no external sound is present.
  • Allergic Rhinitis
